en-US.title: Buki: Kids Art Book
en-US.subtitle: Save Every Little Masterpiece
en-US.description:
Turn piles of children’s drawings into private, beautiful keepsake books.

Buki helps adults capture artwork, organize it by child and sketchpad, and preserve the memories around it—without making children create accounts.

CAPTURE EVERY MASTERPIECE
• Photograph a drawing or import it from Photos
• Keep a clean artwork image and the original photo together
• Add a title, artwork date, notes, tags, and favorites

BUILD BEAUTIFUL SKETCHPADS
• Browse art in spread, portrait, grid, album, and filmstrip layouts
• Choose playful covers, page colors, themes, borders, and decorations
• Search, filter, and organize the family library

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Artwork saves locally first and remains available offline
• Children are profiles owned by an adult, not separate login accounts
• There is no public gallery and Buki does not use children’s artwork for advertising
• Adults control backup, restore, export, and deletion

FREE AND PRO
Free includes one child, one sketchpad, and up to 20 artworks. Buki Pro unlocks unlimited local child profiles, sketchpads, and artworks, plus premium organization, protected exports, and 2 GB of private cloud backup. Monthly, yearly, and lifetime options unlock the same Pro features; Apple shows the final localized price.

Keep the art. Keep the story. Build a Buki together.
